name: dsh-devops-tasks
description: My workbench for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar panel with two tabs. The sessions tab lists every local session as a card (official StateDot status glyph, clamped title, inline note with turn count and token usage, workspace, pin, sidebar locate, and a three-dot menu with pin/rename/fork/copy session id/open in app/archive, workspace filter, pinned-first then last-used order). The DevOps tab loads the three "about me" buckets of the company DevOps platform (待办 / 待审 / 我创建的) with counts, type/status/priority/task-point columns, due dates and owner. Data comes from the devops-mcp-agile MCP server through a zero-dependency MCP Streamable-HTTP client in the host process, so the access token never reaches the browser; the endpoint is discovered from the profile's cordis patch files. Ships a sidebar panel plus a loopback-only host route. Zero runtime dependencies.
